verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.

verses.he: שְׁמַע־אֱלֹהִ֣ים קוֹלִ֣י בְשִׂיחִ֑י מִפַּ֥חַד א֝וֹיֵ֗ב תִּצֹּ֥ר חַיָּֽי׃
verses.en: Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; Preserve my life from the terror of the enemy.

verses.he: תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי מִסּ֣וֹד מְרֵעִ֑ים מֵ֝רִגְשַׁ֗ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: Hide me from the council of evil-doers; From the tumult of the workers of iniquity;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁנְנ֣וּ כַחֶ֣רֶב לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם דָּרְכ֥וּ חִ֝צָּ֗ם דָּבָ֥ר מָֽר׃
verses.en: Who have whet their tongue like a sword, And have aimed their arrow, a poisoned word;

verses.he: לִיר֣וֹת בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֣ים תָּ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם יֹ֝רֻ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א יִירָֽאוּ׃
verses.en: That they may shoot in secret places at the blameless; Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

verses.he: יְחַזְּקוּ־לָ֨מוֹ׀ דָּ֘בָ֤ר רָ֗ע יְֽ֭סַפְּרוּ לִטְמ֣וֹן מוֹקְשִׁ֑ים אָ֝מְר֗וּ מִ֣י יִרְאֶה־לָּֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: They encourage one another in an evil matter; They converse of laying snares secretly; They ask, who would see them.

verses.he: יַֽחְפְּֽשׂוּ־עוֹלֹ֗ת תַּ֭מְנוּ חֵ֣פֶשׂ מְחֻפָּ֑שׂ וְקֶ֥רֶב אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֵ֣ב עָמֹֽק׃
verses.en: They search out iniquities, they have accomplished a diligent search; Even in the inward thought of every one, and the deep heart.

verses.he: וַיֹּרֵ֗ם אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֥ץ פִּתְא֑וֹם הָ֝י֗וּ מַכּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: But God doth shoot at them with an arrow suddenly; Thence are their wounds.

verses.he: וַיַּכְשִׁיל֣וּהוּ עָלֵ֣ימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם יִ֝תְנֹדֲד֗וּ כָּל־רֹ֥אֵה בָֽם׃
verses.en: So they make their own tongue a stumbling unto themselves; All that see them shake the head.

verses.he: וַיִּֽירְא֗וּ כָּל־אָ֫דָ֥ם וַ֭יַּגִּידוּ פֹּ֥עַל אֱלֹהִ֗ים וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥הוּ הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
verses.en: And all men fear; And they declare the work of God, And understand His doing.

verses.he: יִשְׂמַ֬ח צַדִּ֣יק בַּ֭יהוָה וְחָ֣סָה ב֑וֹ וְ֝יִתְהַֽלְל֗וּ כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃
verses.en: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in Him; And all the upright in heart shall glory.
